Python Django PostgreSQL REST API

Student Academic Management System

Designed and delivered a full-stack web application using Django and PostgreSQL to digitalise and streamline academic record management for educational institutions. The platform enforces granular role-based access control for administrators, faculty, and students — providing secure grade management, real-time attendance tracking, automated timetable generation, and scheduled report exports. Exposed via a clean REST API layer, the architecture is designed for seamless future mobile and third-party integration.

Sales Data Analysis & Reporting Pipeline

Built a robust, end-to-end data analysis pipeline using Python, Pandas, and NumPy to ingest and process large-scale retail sales datasets with minimal latency. The solution automates data validation, cleansing, anomaly detection, trend analysis, and KPI computation — surfacing results through an interactive Flask dashboard with dynamic filtering. Eliminated error-prone manual reporting workflows entirely, delivering a reproducible, version-controlled pipeline that cuts reporting cycle time significantly.

About Me

A driven engineer who turns data into decisions and ideas into working software.

I am Hamzo Khan, a Software Engineering professional based at Mehran University of Engineering and Technology (MUET), Jamshoro. My core focus lies at the intersection of Python development and data analysis — disciplines I pursue with both rigour and genuine enthusiasm.

I specialise in extracting actionable insights from complex datasets using NumPy and Pandas, and in building robust, production-ready backend systems with Django and Flask. I am equally comfortable designing relational schemas in PostgreSQL and working with document-based stores in MongoDB.

My Final Year Project reflects where these skills converge: I am designing an automated computer-vision pipeline that identifies semiconductor components and detects surface-level manufacturing defects — applying deep learning to solve a tangible industry challenge.

My ambition is to grow into a Python Developer and Data Analyst who delivers measurable impact — writing clean, maintainable code, drawing meaningful conclusions from complex data, and contributing to high-performing teams that build software that matters.
